_comment: OpenPPL/OpenHoldem symbol registry, descriptions below are written independently, from each symbol's NAME and general poker/PokerTracker domain knowledge, not copied or closely paraphrased from the OpenPPL manual's own prose . Every entry not marked confidence:medium is a description composed fresh from the name alone; medium-confidence entries are flagged because the name alone was genuinely ambiguous, not because the description leans on the manual's wording, those were still written independently, just with lower certainty of being exactly right. Types are inferred from naming convention (Have.../Had.../In.../Bot.../No... = boolean; Number.../Raises/Calls/.../Position = integer; Size/Stack/Pot/Amount/Invested = decimal amount; ...Rank = integer 2-14) and not independently confirmed against a running OpenHoldem instance.

BettingAction.name: AllOpponentsLeftSittingOut
BettingAction.meaning: True when every opponent still in the hand is currently sitting out.

BettingAction.name: Bets
BettingAction.meaning: The number of bets made so far in the current betting round.

BettingAction.name: BigBlindSittingOut
BettingAction.meaning: True if the player in the big blind seat is sitting out.

BettingAction.name: BotCalledBeforeFlop
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot called at least once during the preflop round.

BettingAction.name: BotCalledOnFlop
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot called at least once during the flop round.

BettingAction.name: BotCalledOnTurn
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot called at least once during the turn round.

BettingAction.name: BotCalledOnRiver
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot called at least once during the river round.

BettingAction.name: BotIsLastRaiser
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot made the most recent raise in the hand.

BettingAction.name: BotRaisedBeforeFlop
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot raised at least once during the preflop round.

BettingAction.name: BotRaisedOnFlop
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot raised at least once during the flop round.

BettingAction.name: BotRaisedOnTurn
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot raised at least once during the turn round.

BettingAction.name: BotsActionsOnFlop
BettingAction.meaning: How many actions the bot has taken so far on the flop.

BettingAction.name: BotsActionsOnThisRound
BettingAction.meaning: How many actions the bot has taken so far in the current betting round.

BettingAction.name: BotsActionsOnThisRoundIncludingChecks
BettingAction.meaning: Same count as BotsActionsOnThisRound, but with checks counted as an action too.

BettingAction.name: BotsActionsPreflop
BettingAction.meaning: How many actions the bot has taken so far during the preflop round.

BettingAction.name: BotCheckedPreflop
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot checked at least once during the preflop round.

BettingAction.name: BotCheckedOnFlop
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot checked at least once during the flop round.

BettingAction.name: BotCheckedOnTurn
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot checked at least once during the turn round.

BettingAction.name: BotCheckedOnRiver
BettingAction.meaning: True if the bot checked at least once during the river round.

BettingAction.name: BotsLastAction
BettingAction.meaning: A code identifying the bot's most recent action in the hand.

BettingAction.name: BotsLastPreflopAction
BettingAction.meaning: A code identifying the bot's most recent action during the preflop round.

BettingAction.name: BotsLastFlopAction
BettingAction.meaning: A code identifying the bot's most recent action during the flop round.

BettingAction.name: BotsLastTurnAction
BettingAction.meaning: A code identifying the bot's most recent action during the turn round.

BettingAction.name: Calls
BettingAction.meaning: The number of calls made so far in the current betting round.

BettingAction.name: CallsSinceLastRaise
BettingAction.meaning: The number of calls made since the most recent raise.

BettingAction.name: Checks
BettingAction.meaning: The number of checks made so far in the current betting round.

BettingAction.name: Folds
BettingAction.meaning: The number of folds made so far in the current betting round.

BettingAction.name: MissingSmallBlind
BettingAction.meaning: True if no small blind was posted this hand (e.g. the seat is empty).

BettingAction.name: NoBettingOnFlop
BettingAction.meaning: True if nobody has bet or raised during the flop round.

BettingAction.name: NoBettingOnTurn
BettingAction.meaning: True if nobody has bet or raised during the turn round.

BettingAction.name: NoVillainBetOrRaisedOnFlop
BettingAction.meaning: True if no opponent has bet or raised during the flop round.

BettingAction.name: NoVillainBetOrRaisedOnTurn
BettingAction.meaning: True if no opponent has bet or raised during the turn round.

BettingAction.name: NumberOfOpponentsAllin
BettingAction.meaning: How many opponents are currently all-in.

BettingAction.name: NumberOfRaisesBeforeFlop
BettingAction.meaning: How many raises happened during the preflop round.

BettingAction.name: NumberOfRaisesOnFlop
BettingAction.meaning: How many raises happened during the flop round.

BettingAction.name: NumberOfRaisesOnTurn
BettingAction.meaning: How many raises happened during the turn round.

BettingAction.name: OpponentCalledOnFlop
BettingAction.meaning: True if at least one opponent called during the flop round.

BettingAction.name: OpponentCalledOnTurn
BettingAction.meaning: True if at least one opponent called during the turn round.

BettingAction.name: OpponentIsAllin
BettingAction.meaning: True if at least one opponent is currently all-in.

BettingAction.name: Raises
BettingAction.meaning: The number of raises made so far in the current betting round.

BettingAction.name: RaisesBeforeFlop
BettingAction.meaning: The number of raises made during the preflop round.

BettingAction.name: RaisesOnFlop
BettingAction.meaning: The number of raises made during the flop round.

BettingAction.name: RaisesOnTurn
BettingAction.meaning: The number of raises made during the turn round.

BettingAction.name: RaisesSinceLastPlay
BettingAction.meaning: The number of raises made since the bot's own last action.

BettingAction.name: SmallBlindSittingOut
BettingAction.meaning: True if the player in the small blind seat is sitting out.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: AmountToCall
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The size of the bet the bot must call to stay in the hand, in big blinds.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: BetSize
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The size of the most recent bet or raise, in big blinds.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: BigBlindSize
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The size of the big blind for this hand (usually in the table's currency).

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: MaxStacksizeOfActiveOpponents
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The largest stack size, in big blinds, among opponents still in the hand.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: EffectiveMaxStacksizeOfActiveOpponents
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: Like MaxStacksizeOfActiveOpponents, but capped so it never exceeds the bot's own stack (the amount actually at risk).

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: MaxOpponentStackSize
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The largest stack size, in big blinds, among all opponents at the table.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: MaxStillToActStackSize
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The largest stack size, in big blinds, among opponents who still have to act this round.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: MinOpponentStackSize
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The smallest stack size, in big blinds, among all opponents at the table.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: MinStillToActStackSize
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The smallest stack size, in big blinds, among opponents who still have to act this round.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: OpponentStacksizeHeadsUp
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The lone opponent's stack size, in big blinds, when exactly one opponent remains in the hand.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: PotSize
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The total size of the pot, in big blinds, including all bets made so far this round.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: StackSize
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The bot's own current stack size, in big blinds.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: StackSizeAtBeginningOfCurrentRound
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The bot's stack size, in big blinds, at the moment the current betting round began.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: StackUnknown
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: True if the bot's stack size could not be read reliably.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: StartingChips
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The chip count every player started the tournament/session with.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: StartingStackSize
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The bot's stack size, in big blinds, at the very start of the current hand.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: TotalInvested
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The total amount the bot has put into the pot across the whole hand so far.

BetsizesAndStacksizes.name: TotalInvestedThisRound
BetsizesAndStacksizes.meaning: The amount the bot has put into the pot during the current betting round only.

Board.name: SecondTopFlopCardPairedOnRiver
Board.meaning: True if the flop's second-highest card has been paired by the river card. Note: openppl-data/registry/raw_symbols.json's extraction shows this NAME listed twice with a self-referential 'synonym for' description for the second occurrence, an artifact of the manual's own HTML, not a distinction this registry can resolve .

Board.name: SecondTopFlopCardPairedOnTurn
Board.meaning: True if the flop's second-highest card has been paired by the turn card. Same duplicate-listing caveat as SecondTopFlopCardPairedOnRiver above.

Board.name: AcePresentOnFlop
Board.meaning: True if at least one of the three flop cards is an ace.

Board.name: FlushOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if all of the community cards dealt so far are the same suit.

Board.name: FlushPossible
Board.meaning: True if the current board has three or more cards of one suit, making a flush possible.

Board.name: FlushPossibleOnFlop
Board.meaning: True if all three flop cards are the same suit.

Board.name: FlushPossibleOnTurn
Board.meaning: True if a flush is possible using the board as it stood after the turn card.

Board.name: FourCardsToWheelOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if four of the five wheel cards (A, 2, 3, 4, 5) are already on the board.

Board.name: FourOfOneSuitOnTurn
Board.meaning: True if four of the board's cards (flop plus turn) are the same suit.

Board.name: FullHouseOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if the community cards alone already make a full house.

Board.name: HighCardOfCommonStraigh
Board.meaning: The rank of the highest card in a straight that the board itself makes (sic, the manual's own symbol name appears to drop the final 't' of 'Straight').

Board.name: KingPresentOnFlop
Board.meaning: True if at least one of the three flop cards is a king.

Board.name: LowCardsOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if the board consists only of low-ranked cards.

Board.name: MoreThanOneStraightPossibleOnFlop
Board.meaning: True if the flop alone allows more than one distinct straight to be made.

Board.name: MoreThanOneStraightPossibleOnTurn
Board.meaning: True if the board through the turn allows more than one distinct straight to be made.

Board.name: NutsOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if the community cards themselves already make the best possible hand, independent of any hole cards.

Board.name: OneCardFlushPossible
Board.meaning: True if a flush is possible using exactly one hole card plus the board.

Board.name: OneCardStraightFlushPossible
Board.meaning: True if a straight flush is possible using exactly one hole card plus the board.

Board.name: OneCardStraightPossible
Board.meaning: True if a straight is possible using exactly one hole card plus the board.

Board.name: OneCardStraightPossibleOnTurn
Board.meaning: Same as OneCardStraightPossible, evaluated using the board as it stood after the turn card.

Board.name: Only1OneCardStraightPossible
Board.meaning: True if exactly one one-card straight is possible on the current board (as opposed to several).

Board.name: OnlyOneStraightPossible
Board.meaning: True if exactly one distinct straight is possible on the current board.

Board.name: OvercardsOnBoard
Board.meaning: How many community cards rank higher than the bot's hole cards.

Board.name: PairOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if the community cards contain a pair.

Board.name: PairOnFlop
Board.meaning: True if the three flop cards contain a pair.

Board.name: PairOnTurn
Board.meaning: True if the board through the turn contains a pair.

Board.name: QuadsOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if the community cards alone already make four of a kind.

Board.name: QueenPresentOnFlop
Board.meaning: True if at least one of the three flop cards is a queen.

Board.name: RiverCardIsOvercardToBoard
Board.meaning: True if the river card ranks higher than every other community card.

Board.name: RunnerRunnerFlushPossibleAtRiver
Board.meaning: True if a flush could only be completed by both the turn and river being the needed suit (a 'runner-runner' draw), evaluated once the river is known.

Board.name: StraightFlushOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if the community cards alone already make a straight flush.

Board.name: StraightFlushPossible
Board.meaning: True if the current board allows a straight flush to be made.

Board.name: StraightFlushPossibleByOthers
Board.meaning: True if a straight flush is possible for an opponent given the board, independent of the bot's own hole cards.

Board.name: StraightOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if the community cards alone already make a straight.

Board.name: StraightPossible
Board.meaning: True if the current board allows a straight to be made.

Board.name: StraightPossibleOnFlop
Board.meaning: True if the three flop cards alone allow a straight to be made.

Board.name: StraightPossibleOnTurn
Board.meaning: True if the board through the turn allows a straight to be made.

Board.name: SuitsOnBoard
Board.meaning: How many distinct suits appear among the current community cards.

Board.name: SuitsOnFlop
Board.meaning: How many distinct suits appear among the three flop cards.

Board.name: SuitsOnRiver
Board.meaning: How many distinct suits appear among all five community cards, once the river is dealt.

Board.name: SuitsOnTurn
Board.meaning: How many distinct suits appear among the board through the turn card.

Board.name: ThreeCardStraightOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if three of the community cards alone form three consecutive ranks.

Board.name: TopFlopCardPairedOnRiver
Board.meaning: True if the flop's highest card has been paired by the river card.

Board.name: TopFlopCardPairedOnTurn
Board.meaning: True if the flop's highest card has been paired by the turn card.

Board.name: TripsOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if the community cards alone already make three of a kind.

Board.name: TripsOnBoardOnTurn
Board.meaning: True if the board through the turn card alone already makes three of a kind.

Board.name: TurnCardIsOvercardToBoard
Board.meaning: True if the turn card ranks higher than every flop card.

Board.name: TurnCardPaired
Board.meaning: True if the turn card's rank matches a card already on the flop.

Board.name: TwoOfOneSuitPresentOnFlop
Board.meaning: True if exactly two of the three flop cards share a suit.

Board.name: TwoPairOnBoard
Board.meaning: True if the community cards alone already make two pair.

Board.name: TwoPairOnBoardOnTurn
Board.meaning: True if the board through the turn card alone already makes two pair.

Board.name: UncoordinatedFlop
Board.meaning: True if the flop's three cards are unrelated in rank and suit (no pair, no flush/straight draw potential).

Board.name: WheelPossible
Board.meaning: True if an A-2-3-4-5 straight ('the wheel') is possible given the current board.

Handstrength.name: HadOverpairOnFlop
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair ranked higher than every flop card, evaluated at the time of the flop (may no longer hold now).

Handstrength.name: HadOverPairOnTurn
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair ranked higher than every board card, evaluated at the time of the turn.

Handstrength.name: HadPairOnFlop
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot had at least a pair using the flop (may no longer be the bot's best hand now).

Handstrength.name: HadPairOnTurn
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot had at least a pair using the board through the turn.

Handstrength.name: HadSetOnFlop
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot had three of a kind using a pocket pair plus one matching flop card, evaluated at the flop.

Handstrength.name: HadSetOnTurn
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot had three of a kind using a pocket pair plus one matching board card, evaluated at the turn.

Handstrength.name: HadTopPairOnFlop
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot paired the highest-ranked flop card, evaluated at the flop.

Handstrength.name: HadTopPairOnTurn
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot paired the highest-ranked board card, evaluated at the turn.

Handstrength.name: HadTwoPairOnFlop
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot made two pair using the flop, evaluated at the flop.

Handstrength.name: HadSecondOverPairOnFlop
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair ranked higher than exactly one flop card (the second-best overpair tier), evaluated at the flop.

Handstrength.name: HadSecondOverPairOnTurn
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair ranked as the second-best possible overpair given the board through the turn.

Handstrength.name: HadSecondTopPairOnFlop
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot paired the flop's second-highest card, evaluated at the flop.

Handstrength.name: HaveSecondBestKicker
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's side card (kicker) is the second-highest possible kicker given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveSecondBestKickerOrBetter
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's kicker is the second-best possible or better.

Handstrength.name: HaveSecondBestOverPairOrBetter
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's overpair is the second-best possible overpair or better.

Handstrength.name: HaveSecondNutFlush
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds the second-best possible flush given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveSecondNutFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's flush draw would complete to the second-best possible flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveSecondNutStraight
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds the second-best possible straight given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveSecondOverPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair is the second-best possible overpair given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveSecondTopPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot paired the board's second-highest card.

Handstrength.name: HaveSecondTopSet
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's set uses the board's second-highest-ranked card.

Handstrength.name: HaveThirdBestKicker
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's kicker is the third-best possible given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveThirdBestKickerOrBetter
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's kicker is the third-best possible or better.

Handstrength.name: HaveThirdBestOverPairOrBetter
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's overpair is the third-best possible or better.

Handstrength.name: HaveThirdNutFlush
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds the third-best possible flush given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveThirdNutFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's flush draw would complete to the third-best possible flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveThirdOverPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair is the third-best possible overpair given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveThirdTopPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot paired the board's third-highest card.

Handstrength.name: HaveThirdTopSet
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's set uses the board's third-highest-ranked card.

Handstrength.name: HaveFourthNutFlush
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds the fourth-best possible flush given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveFourthNutFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's flush draw would complete to the fourth-best possible flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveFourthOverPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair is the fourth-best possible overpair given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveFourthTopPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot paired the board's fourth-highest card.

Handstrength.name: HaveFourthTopSet
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's set uses the board's fourth-highest-ranked card.

Handstrength.name: HaveFifthNutFlush
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds the fifth-best possible flush given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveFifthNutFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's flush draw would complete to the fifth-best possible flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveFifthOverPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair is the fifth-best possible overpair given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveFifthTopPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot paired the board's fifth-highest card.

Handstrength.name: HaveBackdoorSecondNutFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot needs both remaining community cards to complete the second-best possible flush (a runner-runner draw).

Handstrength.name: HaveBackdoorThirdNutFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot needs both remaining community cards to complete the third-best possible flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveBackdoorFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot needs both remaining community cards to complete a flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveBackdoorNutFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot needs both remaining community cards to complete the best possible flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveBackdoorStraightDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot needs both remaining community cards to complete a straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveBestKicker
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's kicker is the best possible given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveBestKickerOrBetter
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's kicker ties or beats the best possible kicker.

Handstrength.name: HaveBestOverPairOrBetter
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's overpair ties or beats the best possible overpair.

Handstrength.name: HaveBottomPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot paired the board's lowest-ranked card.

Handstrength.name: HaveBottomSet
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's set uses the board's lowest-ranked card.

Handstrength.name: HaveBottomTrips
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's three-of-a-kind uses the board's lowest paired/tripled rank.

Handstrength.name: HaveBottomTwoPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's two pair are the two lowest-ranked pairs possible given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveDoubleGutshotDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot has two separate inside (gutshot) straight draws at once.

Handstrength.name: HaveFlush
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's best hand right now is a flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot needs one more card of a suit to complete a flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveFullHouse
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's best hand right now is a full house.

Handstrength.name: HaveInsideNutStraightDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot has a gutshot draw to the best possible straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveInsideStraightDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot needs one specific inside card (a gutshot) to complete a straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveNothing
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's hand currently has no pair, draw, or other recognized strength at all.

Handstrength.name: HaveNutFlush
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds the best possible flush given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveNutFlushCard
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds the single highest card of the flush suit.

Handstrength.name: HaveNutFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's flush draw would complete to the best possible flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveNuts
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot currently holds the single best possible hand given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveNutStraight
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds the best possible straight given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveNutStraightDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's straight draw would complete to the best possible straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveNutStraightFlush
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds the best possible straight flush given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveOpenEndedStraightDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot needs one of two possible ranks (an open-ended draw) to complete a straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveOverPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair ranks higher than every board card.

Handstrength.name: HavePair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's best hand right now is a pair.

Handstrength.name: HavePocketPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's two hole cards are the same rank.

Handstrength.name: HaveQuads
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's best hand right now is four of a kind.

Handstrength.name: HaveRunnerRunnerFlushAtRiver
Handstrength.meaning: True once the river is known and the bot's flush only came in because both the turn and river were the needed suit.

Handstrength.name: HaveSet
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's three of a kind comes from a pocket pair plus one matching board card.

Handstrength.name: HaveStraight
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's best hand right now is a straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveStraightDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot needs one more card to complete a straight (open-ended or inside).

Handstrength.name: HaveStraightFlush
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's best hand right now is a straight flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveTopNonBoardPairedPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pair is the highest one possible that isn't already paired on the board itself.

Handstrength.name: HaveTopPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot paired the board's highest-ranked card.

Handstrength.name: HaveTopSet
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's set uses the board's highest-ranked card.

Handstrength.name: HaveTopTwoPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's two pair are the two highest-ranked pairs possible given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveTopTrips
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's three-of-a-kind uses the board's highest paired/tripled rank.

Handstrength.name: HaveTrips
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's best hand right now is three of a kind made with one hole card matching a paired board.

Handstrength.name: HaveTwoPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's best hand right now is two pair.

Handstrength.name: HaveUnderPair
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's pocket pair ranks lower than at least one board card.

Handstrength.name: HaveUnderStraight
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot holds a straight lower than the best possible straight given the board.

Handstrength.name: HaveWeakBackdoorStraightDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's backdoor (runner-runner) straight draw is to a low-value straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveWeakDoubleGutshotDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's double gutshot draw would only complete to a low-value straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveWeakFlush
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's flush is a low one, far from the best possible flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveWeakFlushDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's flush draw would complete to a low, weak flush.

Handstrength.name: HaveWeakInsideStraightDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's gutshot straight draw would complete to a low-value straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveWeakStraight
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's straight is low-value, far from the best possible straight.

Handstrength.name: HaveWeakStraightDraw
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's straight draw would complete to a low-value straight.

Handstrength.name: KingPresentOnFlop
Handstrength.meaning: True if at least one of the three flop cards is a king. (Same name also appears in the Board category; kept here too since the raw extraction lists it under both.)

Handstrength.name: NutFullHouseOrFourOfAKind
Handstrength.meaning: A ranking of how strong the bot's full house or quads is relative to the best possible; per the manual's own documented convention, OpenPPL uses 999 to mean 'no full house or quads at all', the opposite convention from Standard PPL's 0.

Handstrength.name: Overcards
Handstrength.meaning: How many of the bot's hole cards rank higher than every board card.

Handstrength.name: PairInHand
Handstrength.meaning: True if the bot's two hole cards are the same rank (a pocket pair).

Handstrength.name: SuitsInHand
Handstrength.meaning: How many distinct suits appear among the bot's hole cards.

Handstrength.name: TopPairRank
Handstrength.meaning: The rank (2-14, ace high) of the bot's top pair, if any.

Handstrength.name: SecondTopPairRank
Handstrength.meaning: The rank of the bot's second-best pair, if holding two pair.

Handstrength.name: ThirdTopPairRank
Handstrength.meaning: The rank involved in the bot's third-best pair-like holding, if applicable.

Handstrength.name: ForthTopPairRank
Handstrength.meaning: The rank involved in the bot's fourth-best pair-like holding (sic, the symbol name itself spells 'Forth', not 'Fourth').

Handstrength.name: FifthTopPairRank
Handstrength.meaning: The rank involved in the bot's fifth-best pair-like holding, if applicable.

Handstrength.name: TopPairKickerRank
Handstrength.meaning: The rank of the bot's other hole card (the kicker) when the bot holds top pair.

Handstrength.name: TripsRank
Handstrength.meaning: The rank of the bot's three of a kind, if any.

Handstrength.name: TripsKickerRank
Handstrength.meaning: The rank of the bot's kicker card when holding three of a kind.

Other.name: IsFinalTable
Other.meaning: True if the current table is the final table of a tournament.

Other.name: Others
Other.meaning: Always evaluates true, conventionally used as the catch-all final condition in a sequence of WHEN rules.

Other.name: Random
Other.meaning: A newly generated random number each time it's evaluated, used to add controlled randomness to decisions.

Player.name: HandIsHeadsup
Player.meaning: True if exactly two players are contesting this pot (possibly after others folded).

Player.name: LastAggressorActsAfterUs
Player.meaning: True if the most recent bettor/raiser acts after the bot in the current betting order.

Player.name: Opponents
Player.meaning: The number of opponents still in the hand.

Player.name: OpponentsAtTable
Player.meaning: The number of opponents seated at the table, regardless of whether they're still in this hand.

Player.name: OpponentsLeft
Player.meaning: The number of opponents who still have to act in the current betting round.

Player.name: OpponentsOnFlop
Player.meaning: The number of opponents who were still in the hand when the flop was dealt.

Player.name: OpponentsWithHigherStack
Player.meaning: The number of opponents whose stack is larger than the bot's own.

Player.name: OpponentsWithLowerStack
Player.meaning: The number of opponents whose stack is smaller than the bot's own.

Player.name: TableIsHeadsup
Player.meaning: True if only two players remain seated at the table (not just this pot).

Position.name: FirstCallerPosition
Position.meaning: The position of the first player to call this hand (big blind = 0, small blind = 1, counting counter-clockwise up to UTG = 9). Only meaningful during the first orbit preflop.

Position.name: FirstRaiserPosition
Position.meaning: The position of the first player to raise this hand, using the same numbering as FirstCallerPosition. Only meaningful during the first orbit preflop.

Position.name: InBigBlind
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in the big blind seat this hand.

Position.name: InButton
Position.meaning: True if the bot is on the button (last to act postflop).

Position.name: InCutOff
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in the cutoff seat (one before the button).

Position.name: InEarlyPosition
Position.meaning: True if the bot is seated in one of the early preflop-acting positions.

Position.name: InEarlyPosition1
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in the first of the early positions.

Position.name: InEarlyPosition2
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in the second of the early positions.

Position.name: InEarlyPosition3
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in the third of the early positions.

Position.name: InLatePosition
Position.meaning: True if the bot is seated in one of the late preflop-acting positions (e.g. cutoff, button).

Position.name: InMiddlePosition
Position.meaning: True if the bot is seated in one of the middle preflop-acting positions.

Position.name: InMiddlePosition1
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in the first of the middle positions.

Position.name: InMiddlePosition2
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in the second of the middle positions.

Position.name: InMiddlePosition3
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in the third of the middle positions.

Position.name: InSmallBlind
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in the small blind seat this hand.

Position.name: InTheBlinds
Position.meaning: True if the bot is in either the small blind or big blind seat this hand.

Position.name: InUTG
Position.meaning: True if the bot is under the gun (first to act preflop).

Position.name: LastCallerPosition
Position.meaning: The position of the most recent player to call, using the same numbering as FirstCallerPosition.

Position.name: LastRaiserPosition
Position.meaning: The position of the most recent player to raise, using the same numbering as FirstCallerPosition.

Position.name: Position
Position.meaning: The bot's own seating position for this hand.

Position.name: StillToAct
Position.meaning: How many players, including the bot, still have to act after the current player in this betting round.

Technical.name: First
Technical.meaning: A named constant for position comparisons, confirmed directly from Mathematical_Expressions.html's own equality-operator example ("Position != First", "true, if you are not out of position"). Not listed in any of the 9 scraped symbol-reference tables; found only because a corpus fixture built from this exact example surfaced it as an otherwise-unexplained name .

Technical.name: Last
Technical.meaning: A named constant for position comparisons, directly confirmed in OpenPPL_In_Practice.html's own Contibetting example ("WHEN Opponents = 2 AND Position = Last RaiseBy 66% FORCE"), the counterpart to "First" above.
The starting stack size of the player in chair N at the beginning of the hand.

Technical.name: BigBlindCurrentBet
Technical.meaning: The current bet amount posted by the big blind.

Technical.name: SmallBlindCurrentBet
Technical.meaning: The current bet amount posted by the small blind.
A named constant for one card rank (Two through Ace), for comparing against rank-valued symbols without hard-coding a raw number.

Technical.name: ConstBetRoundPreflop
Technical.meaning: A named constant identifying the preflop betting round.

Technical.name: ConstBetRoundFlop
Technical.meaning: A named constant identifying the flop betting round.

Technical.name: ConstBetRoundTurn
Technical.meaning: A named constant identifying the turn betting round.

Technical.name: ConstBetRoundRiver
Technical.meaning: A named constant identifying the river betting round.
True if community card N (0-indexed, in deal order) is paired by another community card.

Technical.name: MaximumPossibleBetsizeIndollars
Technical.meaning: The largest bet size currently possible, expressed in the table's currency rather than big blinds.

Technical.name: PT_LastCaller_Chair
Technical.meaning: The chair number of the most recent caller, in PokerTracker's chair-indexed convention.

Technical.name: RankOfSetOnBoard
Technical.meaning: The rank of the three-of-a-kind the community cards themselves make, if any.

Technical.name: RankOfSpareCardWhenTwoPairOnBoard
Technical.meaning: The rank of the fifth, unpaired community card when the board itself makes two pair. (The raw manual extraction contains leftover word-processor formatting codes glued to this name; see docs/ohh-data/registry notes on the same class of issue.)

Technical.name: RankOfTopPairOnBoard
Technical.meaning: The rank of the higher pair when the community cards themselves make a pair or two pair.

Technical.name: SidePot
Technical.meaning: The size of the side pot, if one exists (created when a player goes all-in for less than the full bet).

Technical.name: SidePotInDollars
Technical.meaning: The side pot size, expressed in the table's currency rather than big blinds.
The chair number currently occupying this named seating position.

Technical.name: AggressorChair
Technical.meaning: The chair number of the player who made the most recent bet or raise.
True if the player in this named seating position has raised this hand.

PokerTracker._comment: Fully parametric (confirmed, Betsizes_and_Stacksizes.html's own 'Summary'): a real symbol name is pt_ + one of these base stat names + one postfix (_raischair, _headsup, _smallblind, _bigblind, _dealer, _cutoff, _firstcaller, _lastcaller, _firstraiser, _user, or a chair number 0-9). Meanings below are standard, industry-wide poker-tracking statistic definitions (VPIP, PFR, 3-bet, etc. are well-known terms used across many tracking tools, not specific to the OpenPPL manual's own wording), not derived from the manual's prose.

base_stats.name: icon
base_stats.meaning: PokerTracker's own auto-rate icon code summarizing a player's overall tendencies.

base_stats.name: hands
base_stats.meaning: The number of hands PokerTracker has recorded for this player.

base_stats.name: vpip
base_stats.meaning: Voluntarily Put money In Pot, the percentage of hands this player plays beyond posting blinds.

base_stats.name: pfr
base_stats.meaning: Pre-Flop Raise, the percentage of hands this player raises preflop.

base_stats.name: wtsd
base_stats.meaning: Went To ShowDown, the percentage of hands this player sees through to showdown.

base_stats.name: wssd
base_stats.meaning: Won money at ShowDown, the percentage of showdowns this player wins.

base_stats.name: aggr_factor
base_stats.meaning: Aggression factor, the ratio of this player's bets and raises to their calls, across all streets.

base_stats.name: aggr_factor_without_preflop
base_stats.meaning: Aggression factor computed from postflop action only.

base_stats.name: fold_to_3bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player folds when facing a 3-bet.

base_stats.name: 4bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of opportunities this player re-raises a 3-bet (a 4-bet).

base_stats.name: preflop_aggr_factor
base_stats.meaning: Aggression factor computed from preflop action only.

base_stats.name: preflop_rfi
base_stats.meaning: Raise First In, the percentage of hands this player raises when no one has acted before them preflop.

base_stats.name: preflop_3bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of opportunities this player re-raises a preflop raise (a 3-bet).

base_stats.name: preflop_fold_to_3bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player folds to a preflop 3-bet.

base_stats.name: preflop_called_raise
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player calls a preflop raise rather than folding or re-raising.

base_stats.name: preflop_attempt_steal
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of opportunities this player raises from a late position trying to steal the blinds.

base_stats.name: bigblind_fold_to_steal
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player, from the big blind, folds to a steal-raise.

base_stats.name: smallblind_fold_to_steal
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player, from the small blind, folds to a steal-raise.

base_stats.name: preflop_3bet_vs_steal
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player 3-bets in response to a steal-raise.

base_stats.name: bigblind_3bet_vs_steal
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player, from the big blind, 3-bets in response to a steal-raise.

base_stats.name: smallblind_3bet_vs_steal
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player, from the small blind, 3-bets in response to a steal-raise.

base_stats.name: preflop_4bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of opportunities this player re-raises a 3-bet preflop.

base_stats.name: preflop_fold_to_4bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player folds to a preflop 4-bet.

base_stats.name: flop_seen
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of hands this player sees the flop.

base_stats.name: flop_aggr_factor
base_stats.meaning: Aggression factor computed from flop action only.

base_stats.name: flop_cbet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of opportunities this player continuation-bets the flop after raising preflop.

base_stats.name: flop_fold_to_cbet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player folds when facing a flop continuation bet.

base_stats.name: flop_raise_cbet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player raises when facing a flop continuation bet.

base_stats.name: flop_fold_to_3bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player folds to a raise on the flop.

base_stats.name: flop_checkraise
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of opportunities this player check-raises on the flop.

base_stats.name: flop_donkbet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player bets into the previous street's aggressor on the flop (a 'donk bet').

base_stats.name: turn_seen
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of hands this player sees the turn.

base_stats.name: turn_aggr_factor
base_stats.meaning: Aggression factor computed from turn action only.

base_stats.name: turn_cbet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of opportunities this player continuation-bets the turn.

base_stats.name: turn_fold_to_cbet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player folds when facing a turn continuation bet.

base_stats.name: turn_fold_to_3bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player folds to a raise on the turn.

base_stats.name: turn_checkraise
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of opportunities this player check-raises on the turn.

base_stats.name: turn_checkcall
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player checks then calls on the turn.

base_stats.name: river_seen
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of hands this player sees the river.

base_stats.name: river_aggr_factor
base_stats.meaning: Aggression factor computed from river action only.

base_stats.name: river_fold_to_3bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player folds to a raise on the river.

base_stats.name: river_fold_to_cbet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of the time this player folds when facing a river continuation bet.

base_stats.name: river_bet
base_stats.meaning: The percentage of opportunities this player bets on the river.
